digest.component_or_area: environment identity initialization and op-cert attestation
propositions: re-cloning a tracker without preserving .env-id silently mints a new environment identity, invalidating all op-cert attestations signed by the prior environment
minting .env-id over a store that already holds events from another environment must warn loudly with an explicit override (REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1) and never complete silently
fsck must detect and report ENV_ID_MISMATCH when the current environment's authors also wrote events under a different environment id, indicating orphaned attestations
the carry-over requirements for re-clone operations (.env-id, .opcert-key, .opcert-key.pub, .ensure-applied) must be documented with explanation of what breaks per file
env-id minting into an empty store (genesis init) must succeed silently with no warning to avoid regression
the init ensure-registry unit for env-id must be extracted into a new leaf module (env_identity.py) to stay within module-size constraints
